html:
Bay Mau Coconut Forest, located just a few kilometers from Hoi An Ancient Town, is one of the most distinctive eco-tourism destinations in Central Vietnam. Famous for its lush water coconut palms, peaceful waterways, and vibrant local culture, this area offers visitors a chance to experience the authentic river-life lifestyle of rural Vietnam.

From riding traditional basket boats and watching exciting boat-spinning performances to learning coconut-leaf handicrafts and enjoying local cuisine, Bay Mau Coconut Forest promises memorable experiences for travelers visiting Hoi An in 2026.

Where Is Bay Mau Coconut Forest And Its Historical Background

Bay Mau Coconut Forest is located in Cam Thanh Commune, Hoi An City, Quang Nam Province, approximately 3 kilometers from Hoi An Ancient Town. Thanks to its convenient location, visitors can easily reach the forest by motorbike, bicycle, or taxi in about 7–10 minutes.

The name “Bay Mau” (meaning “Seven Acres”) originates from the forest’s original size of around seven acres. Over time, sediment accumulation expanded the forest into a large mangrove ecosystem rich in biodiversity.

Beyond its natural beauty, Bay Mau Coconut Forest also holds historical significance. During the Vietnam War, this dense coconut forest served as a revolutionary base, providing shelter and transportation routes for local resistance forces. Today, stories shared by local boatmen help visitors understand the forest’s important role in history, adding depth to the travel experience.

Best Time To Visit Bay Mau Coconut Forest

Bay Mau Coconut Forest is open year-round, but certain periods offer more favorable conditions:

February To April

This is the best time to visit, with mild temperatures, minimal rain, and comfortable weather for outdoor activities such as basket boat rides, cycling, and photography.

May To July

Although summer can be hot, this period coincides with lively festivals in Hoi An. Travelers often combine a forest visit with beach trips to An Bang or Cua Dai for relaxation.

September To October (Lunar August)

Considered by locals as the most beautiful season, higher water levels allow basket boats to travel deeper into small canals. Light rain enhances the scenery, creating a peaceful and romantic atmosphere.

October To December

This is the rainy and stormy season. While the scenery can be dramatic, travel conditions may be less convenient.

Unmissable Experiences At Bay Mau Coconut Forest

1. Basket Boat Ride Through Coconut Waterways

The highlight of any visit is riding a traditional round basket boat, guided by friendly and experienced local boatmen. Gliding through narrow canals under dense coconut palms offers a refreshing and relaxing escape from busy city life.

2. Basket Boat Spinning Shows And Races

Visitors can enjoy thrilling basket boat spinning performances, showcasing impressive balance and rowing skills. Guests may also participate in fun boat races, creating laughter and unforgettable memories.

3. Coconut Leaf Handicraft Workshop

Learn how to make simple souvenirs such as rings, grasshoppers, fans, or bracelets from fresh coconut leaves. This hands-on activity offers insight into local craftsmanship and daily life.

4. Enjoy Local Cuisine

After exploring the forest, travelers can dine at riverside restaurants serving fresh seafood and regional specialties. Popular dishes include grilled fish, shrimp, Vietnamese pancakes, and coconut-based desserts, accompanied by refreshing fresh coconut water.

5. Cycling Through Cam Thanh Village

Cycling around Cam Thanh village allows visitors to observe rural life, rice fields, traditional houses, and friendly locals. It is an excellent way to experience the peaceful countryside surrounding Hoi An.

6. Fishing With Local Fishermen

For a deeper cultural experience, travelers can join local fishermen to learn traditional fishing techniques such as net casting and crab trapping, followed by enjoying freshly prepared seafood.

7. Visit Nearby Traditional Craft Villages

Nearby villages such as Thanh Ha Pottery Village and Kim Bong Carpentry Village provide additional cultural exploration, where visitors can witness traditional craftsmanship passed down through generations.

Practical Travel Tips

  • Entrance Fee: Approximately 30,000 VND per person

  • Basket Boat Rental: Around 150,000–200,000 VND per boat (2–4 people)

  • What To Wear: Light, comfortable clothing; hat, sunscreen, and sunglasses

  • Safety: Always wear a life jacket during boat rides

  • Environmental Awareness: Help protect the ecosystem by avoiding littering

Accommodation And Nearby Attractions

Visitors can choose from homestays in Cam Thanh for an authentic local experience or hotels and resorts in Hoi An Ancient Town for greater comfort. Bay Mau Coconut Forest is easily combined with visits to Hoi An Old Town, An Bang Beach, Cua Dai Beach, and other cultural landmarks.

Culture And Local Life

What makes Bay Mau Coconut Forest truly special is not only its landscape but also its people. The residents of Cam Thanh are known for their warmth and hospitality. Their knowledge of the forest, traditional basket boats, and sustainable living practices reflect a deep connection with nature.

A visit here offers a refreshing pause from urban life, allowing travelers to reconnect with nature, history, and local traditions in a meaningful way.

Final Thoughts

Bay Mau Coconut Forest is more than just a tourist attraction it is a symbol of resilience, cultural heritage, and sustainable eco-tourism in Hoi An. Whether you are seeking relaxation, cultural discovery, or hands-on experiences, this destination offers something unique and memorable for every traveler.
